mapper.select: SELECT t.marking_task_id, t.marking_task_task_id, t.marking_task_status, t.marking_task_mode, t.marking_task_paper_id, t.marking_task_exam_id, t.marking_task_student_id, t.marking_task_max_score, t.marking_task_image_path, t.marking_task_answer_sheet_id, t.marking_task_stage, t.marking_task_total, t.marking_task_done_count, t.marking_task_error, t.marking_task_start_time, t.marking_task_finish_time, t.marking_task_teacher_finished, t.marking_task_teacher_finish_time, t.marking_task_satisfaction, t.marking_task_owner_user_id AS owner_user_id, t.create_name, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_name, t.update_by, t.update_time FROM edu_marking_task t WHERE t.marking_task_task_id = #{taskId} LIMIT 1

SELECT t.marking_task_id, t.marking_task_task_id, t.marking_task_status, t.marking_task_mode, t.marking_task_paper_id, t.marking_task_exam_id, t.marking_task_student_id, t.marking_task_max_score, t.marking_task_image_path, t.marking_task_answer_sheet_id, t.marking_task_stage, t.marking_task_total, t.marking_task_done_count, t.marking_task_error, t.marking_task_start_time, t.marking_task_finish_time, t.marking_task_teacher_finished, t.marking_task_teacher_finish_time, t.marking_task_satisfaction, t.marking_task_owner_user_id AS owner_user_id, t.create_name, t.create_by, t.create_time, t.update_name, t.update_by, t.update_time FROM edu_marking_task t WHERE t.marking_task_status IN (0, 1) ORDER BY t.marking_task_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE edu_marking_task SET marking_task_status = 1, marking_task_start_time = #{now}, marking_task_stage = '识别中', marking_task_error = NULL, update_time = #{now} WHERE marking_task_task_id = #{taskId} AND marking_task_status = 0
